changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate task entries and normalized to 'Other:Data-to-Text Generation'. Simplified outputs to one clear description.
PARENT metric is correctly identified as the main automatic evaluation metric used throughout the paper.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The LLMs mentioned (T5-11b, Mistral-7b, Llama-2-13b) were used as generation models being evaluated, not as evaluators.
The paper does not conduct human evaluations. All evaluations are based on automatic metrics and algorithmic assessments.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on compositional generalization evaluation in data-to-text generation using automatic metrics. Key contributions include the SPOR framework evaluating systematicity, productivity, order invariance, and rule learnability. All models were fine-tuned using LoRA and evaluated primarily using PARENT metric.
